title: Fix it without being told how
drDigitalIntro:
This is your assessment for this unit. There are no step-by-step instructions this time — just a list of things to accomplish.

- Nothing will glow yellow. You decide where to click.
- You can do the objectives in any order.
- Open the objectives list with the small arrow in the dark bar to see what is left.
- If you get stuck, the Hint button gives you a nudge — not the answer.

An app on this desktop has stopped responding. Work out what is wrong, force it to quit, and then prove the computer is healthy again by using the app.

playgroundTask.scenario: An unresponsive app the learner must diagnose, force quit, reopen, and verify
playgroundTask.goal: You diagnosed and fixed the problem yourself
playgroundTask.hint: A frozen app ignores clicks — try clicking it and watch what does not happen. When an app will not close normally, the system menu at the top has a stronger option.

steps.say: Something on this desktop is not responding. Work out which app it is.
Normal closing will not work on it. Find the system menu that can.
Prove it is working by typing something into it.

drDigitalSuccess: You noticed the symptom, forced the app to quit, restarted it, and confirmed it works — the exact sequence to run on a real computer before you call anyone for help.
drDigitalHint: Click the app window and see whether anything responds. The menu bar at the top of the screen has an option for shutting down an app that has stopped answering.
